releases.notes:
Caffeinated **Version 1.0.2** fixes some bugs and provides more language options!

## Additions
* Added Spanish translations (Argentinian, European, and Mexican; Thanks to @ExDrill)
* Added Russian translations (Thanks to @xvein)

## Changes
* Coffee shrubs now generate more frequently in jungle biomes

## Fixes
* The advancement "Wake Up and Smell the Coffee" now properly works again

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Chikorita-Lover/Caffeinated/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2

mods.name: Caffeinated
mods.description: Adds new coffee shrubs and items that provide a new caffeine effect.

releases.notes:
Caffeinated **Version 1.0.1** brings the exciting coffee mod to _Minecraft_'s latest version, 1.20.0!

## Additions
* Added a statistic to measure how much coffee has been taken from cauldrons
* Coffee cauldrons now reward experience after brewing coffee

## Changes
* Caffeinated's items have been repositioned in the creative inventory
* Coffee berry crates now have a map color

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Chikorita-Lover/Caffeinated/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1
